_comment: DATED, STATIC pricing ballpark for v1. Deterministic — the LLM must never invent these. Figures are rough on-demand approximations for a general-purpose vCPU+RAM service and per-GB internet egress; refresh periodically and update _as_of. NOT a quote.

_units.compute: USD per vCPU-hour and USD per GB-RAM-hour

_source: AWS compute coefficients derived from Vantage ec2instances.info live data (m5/m6i on-demand Linux, mean $/vCPU across regions, split 25% to RAM). GCP/Azure + all egress remain static. Directional, not a quote.
